files_or_snippet: TokenStream scanning methods: next, newToken, isWhitespace, isRadixInteger, isNumber, isName (structure), isOperator (structure)
how_adapted: Converted from prototype functions to an ES class; removed strings/comments/brackets/named ops/consts; added uppercase 0X/0B, exponent only after a valid mantissa, error throwing as CalcError with position, names restricted to [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Parser (recursive descent with implicit multiplication and spec precedence), evaluator, builtins, calculator state and REPL were written new because expr-eval's precedence/grammar differs from the spec.
